title: If Your Mom Texts You From Downstairs at 3 AM… Don't Answer #scarystories #horror #shorts

beats.text: If your mom texts you at 3 AM asking you to come downstairs…

overlay.message: Can you come downstairs? I need help.

beats.text: This is Cedar Falls. A quiet town where nothing ever happens.
It's 3:07 AM. Your house is silent.

overlay.message: Please hurry. Don't turn on the lights.

beats.text: You start down the hallway. The kitchen door is open.
Something is standing in the doorway, waiting for you.
Then a second alert lights up your screen.
And your mom… is sleeping right next to you.
